arrow.source: The nocked arrow is a proof effect, not a weapon part: rProofEffectList records attach the model effect/base/cm100_900 to a player joint (520 = joint 12, right hand, (-10, 0, 45) cm, rot 0; 521/620 = joint 12, (-120, 0, 0) cm, -90 deg about Y; 621 = joint 8, (22, 0, 0) cm, +90 about Y; 630 = joint 12, (-27, 0, 0); 640 = joint 12, (-10, 0, -55), 180 about Y). The arrow shell (uShellPlw10_000, shell 2000) uses 600/610 with effect/pep parameters. The model's group 0 is the arrow; groups 1-3 are LOD/variant meshes (hidden).
arrow.showProv: off by default: the game requests these proof effects from code whose site was not found (no 520 constant anywhere, not in the motion sequence lists, command tables, shell or param files). Raven picks the placement per animation; each option is a ROM record.

frame.prov: rom: uProofEffect compose 0x0031d16c (mode 0, sub-mode 0): position = joint world matrix x record position; rotation = joint rows normalised, decomposed with the PLAYER's angle order (0x007c3638 for 0), re-applied as Rz,Rx,Ry (0x0031eb84, order 4) times the record rotation, rebuilt in order 4 (0x00320ed4), kept as the effect's order (+0x38 <- 4 at 0x009b3308). The player's order is the unit default 0 (cUnit ctor 0x00885954 leaves +0x38; no player ctor writes it); action states writing 1 and 4 exist and which the Bow's shots use was not read -- weapon.setPlayerOrder(n) compares.
